newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leung Kee mulls sale of Sharp Brave stake.
newsitem.headline: Leung Kee mulls sale of Sharp Brave stake.

text.p: Construction concern Leung Kee Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday a third party had expressed interest in buying all or part of its 71.3 percent stake in electronic translator maker Sharp Brave Holdings Ltd.
"The potential buyer is an independent third party," Leung Kee said in a statement.
"And up to the moment, there has been no discussion between Leung Kee and the potential buyer on the transaction which may or may not proceed."
Leung Kee shares were down HK$0.002 to HK$0.204 at midday while Sharp Brave shares rose HK$0.057 to HK$0.237.
